about_the_game:
Inspired by late night 70's & 80's classic slasher tv movies,vhs tapes and games

"Ax Angel Studios - Slasher 79 Horror BGM Collection" is a collection of audio assets suitable for  all of your horror game development needs.

With heart pumping beats to unsettling synth melodies,this BGM collection is perfect for your RPG,horror,mystery,thriller and retro games.

 

With 11 total tracks, this creepy campy Horror themed BGM music Collection is sure to fill the needs of your horror themed projects!

 

Contents:

11 tracks  (9 Original +2 Bonus Alt Songs All loopable)

 In the following formats: Ogg, M4a, Mp3, Wav

* No AI was used in the creation of this music 

-----------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
